'''TT24 holdout blaster''' was a make of [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During this time some [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], including supervisor [[Cal Alsen]], used a TT24 as their primary weapon. The [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] could be set to a stun setting if needed.<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
TT24 holdout blasters first appeared in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written for the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game by [[Sterling Hershey]] and released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]].
